description: This C# source file defines the SqlQueryFieldTypeProvider class, which implements ISchemaBuilder to register SQL queries as GraphQL queries within OrchardCore. It includes methods for building GraphQL field types based on query schemas and content types, and handles query execution and schema parsing.

classes.name: SqlQueryFieldTypeProvider
classes.description: Implements ISchemaBuilder to register SQL queries as GraphQL queries, building schema fields based on query schemas and content types, and resolving query results.

methods.name: GetIdentifierAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier for the schema, delegating to the query manager.

methods.name: BuildAsync
methods.description: Builds the GraphQL schema by adding fields for each SQL query, parsing schemas, and handling content item types.

methods.name: BuildSchemaBasedFieldType
methods.description: Creates a GraphQL field type based on a JSON schema, supporting string and integer types, with resolvers for query execution.

methods.name: BuildContentTypeFieldType
methods.description: Creates a GraphQL field type for content items, resolving queries for specific content types.
